description: **Junk Butler tidies up at every vendor: it sells your grey items, repairs your gear and tells you the result in one chat line.**
## Features
- Sells every grey item that has a vendor price as soon as you open a vendor, a few items at a time.
- Repairs all your gear at vendors that can repair, paid from your own gold.
- One chat line: how many items were sold, for how much, and what the repair cost.
- Hold Shift while you open a vendor to skip both for that visit.
## How to use
Install it and talk to a vendor, nothing else is needed. `/jb` (or `/junkbutler`) shows the settings. `/jb sell` and `/jb repair` switch each half on or off.
## In detail
### Sell grey items

When a vendor window opens, Junk Butler looks through your bags for grey items of poor quality that have a sell price. Locked items and items without a sell value stay where they are. It sells six bag slots at a time with a short pause between the steps, and reads every slot again right before selling, in case something moved. If you close the vendor early, it stops and reports what was sold so far.
### Auto repair

At a vendor that can repair, it repairs all your gear first, paid from your own gold and never from the guild bank. If your gold is short, it waits until the sale is done and tries once more. When the gold still does not reach, the chat line tells you what the repair would cost.
### The chat line
At the end of the visit you get one line with the number of junk items sold, the gold they brought and the price of the repair. When there was nothing to sell and nothing to repair, it stays quiet.
### Commands
- `/jb` – shows whether selling and repairing are on.
- `/jb sell` – switches selling grey items on or off.
- `/jb repair` – switches auto repair on or off.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail. No combat data, which the Midnight expansion hides from addons. It only acts while a vendor window is open.
- The addon is in English.
- It only sells grey items. White, green and better items are never touched.
- Both halves are on after installing. Settings are shared by all your characters and saved until you change them.
- Sold something by mistake? The vendor's buyback tab has it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
*(The logo is AI-generated.)*
